title: Ultra-wideband Based Robot Swarm Coordinate Rapid Initialization in GNSS-Denied and Motion-Constrained Environments
authors: Xiang J.; He X.; Zhang L.; Du X.; He R.; Liu R.; Mao J.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
